title: Hackers Abuse ScreenConnect Vulnerability to Install Rogue Remote Access Clients on Technician Systems
content_md: Hackers are exploiting CVE-2026-84869 in ConnectWise ScreenConnect to execute malicious files on technicians’ workstations and deploy attacker-controlled remote access clients. Huntress confirmed a November 12 compromise in which a guest-pushed batch file notified a Telegram bot, downloaded an installer, and established a rogue ScreenConnect connection within approximately nine seconds.
